title: Codex Local Board — 繁體中文本機工作進度與 Agent 分工看板
resourceType: Local-first Codex conversation progress dashboard / agent status reporter
purpose: 透過本機唯讀 Codex 對話索引及 Codex 主動提交的結構化工作報告，整理每個聊天室的目標、目前進度、下一步、可驗證成果、任務關卡、專案階層與真實子代理分工。
recommendation: 適合研究多專案 Codex 工作監控、AI Agent Workspace 與 Harness 可觀測性。特別可借鏡證據導向驗收、結構化狀態回報、已完成關卡與整體專案分開計算、明確區分執行中與未知，以及手動確認的任務交接。

architecture.core: Node.js 18+ standard-library local HTTP board, read-only observation of Codex session metadata; Node 24.22.2 recommended for node:sqlite support; JSON files for semantic reports and project plans.
architecture.reporting: Working Codex explicitly writes state-v2.json through agent_report.mjs; plan_report.mjs writes project-plans.json. Prior Codex chats can be summarized by a user-triggered Sync-All-Chats action that consumes existing Codex model quota.
architecture.refresh: Browser refreshes state every five seconds; refresh does not itself invoke an AI model.
architecture.optional: Codex Agent View hooks for explicit live execution/subagent/tool events, requiring separate install and trust review; Python v1 legacy checkpoints remain supported.

verificationNotes: The public GitHub Pages demo contains fixed sample data and does not read visitor local Codex chats.
Completed progress counts only done/passed/frozen checkpoints with evidence; tool calls, elapsed time or source_ready are not proof of completion.
Full project plan progress is separate from the current task's checkpoint ratio; unknown scope yields unknown overall completion.
Existing chat sync requires explicit execution, can consume model quota, and may omit conversations due to input limits.
Agent View is optional, externally licensed, and its event stream does not reconstruct past activity or guarantee every hook fires.
Local private summaries and configuration backups can contain sensitive information; do not publish them.
README describes a Windows portable launcher; no installation, execution or independent testing performed.

source.type: Official GitHub README, repository metadata and project website
source.summary: Categorized as one Resource; no standalone project SKILL.md confirmed.
